title: Invoicing the Standing Charge a Micro Market Carries while Closed Off
content:
A micro market in the Unattended Micro Market Program that has been closed off at the client's instruction still carries a standing charge for the period, and that charge is invoiced to the client on the settlement invoice for the period. It takes the place of the ordinary equipment line on the invoice, and the balance owing on the agreement rises by it.

## What the standing settlement does not carry

No portfolio discount is taken off a settlement raised for a period the market stood shut, the standing charge and the fee share already reflecting that the market was not trading.

## Raising the charge

The tool `post_market_standby_settlement_ab27821d` raises the standing charge. It is an agent-side tool: the desk unlocks it and then calls it, one call adding a single monthly settlement charge to the named settlement invoice on that agreement's ledger for a period the market stood shut.

### Parameters

- `market_agreement_id` — the reference number identifying the micro market agreement being invoiced, as returned by the micro market agreement lookup.
- `invoice_reference` — the settlement invoice the charge is placed on, written as INV-MK- followed by 6 digits exactly as it is printed on the invoice. An empty value is not accepted.
- `service_period` — the settlement period the charge covers, written as YYYY-MM with no other text. An empty value is not accepted.
- `standby_settlement_usd` — the standing charge to invoice for that period, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent at the point of booking, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent. A negative value is not accepted.

### Return

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, carrying the reference number minted for the new standing charge, the settlement invoice it was placed on, and the amount invoiced in USD to two decimal places. Receiving that sentence means the charge is on the invoice; no other outcome is reported.

## The effect on the client's account

Afterwards the client sees that charge on the invoice in place of the ordinary equipment line and owes that much more on the agreement.
